blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: A Project-Management App ★★★★☆
paras: **Not only does** this app organize tasks, **it also** predicts delays. **Not just** the interface **but also** the support team deserves praise. **Both** managers **and** interns find it intuitive, **as well as** affordable.
**Not only is** the price fair, **but** the free trial **is also** generous. **Nowhere else** have I found such flexibility.

frames.title: Not only… but also e alternativas

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Not only does it organize tasks, it also predicts delays.**
**Both managers and interns find it intuitive.**
**It is intuitive, as well as affordable.**
**Not just the interface but also the support.**
blocks.cap: Not only… but also e alternativas

blocks.body: **as well as** é menos enfático que **not only… but also**. Com **both**, use exatamente dois itens.
Cuidado: com **not only** invertido, a segunda parte pode vir sem inversão: *it also predicts delays*.

items.s: Not only ___ the app organize tasks. (does)
___ managers and interns find it intuitive. (Both)
It is intuitive, as ___ as affordable. (well)
Nowhere ___ have I found such flexibility. (else)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

**Hands down.** — Sem dúvida.
**Value for money.** — Custo-benefício.
**Game changer.** — Algo que muda tudo.
**Easy on the eye.** — Agradável de ver.
**Fit for purpose.** — Adequado ao uso.
**Second to none.** — Sem igual.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence product review using not only… but also with inversion, plus both… and and as well as.
blocks.model: Not only does this app organize tasks, it also predicts delays. Both managers and interns find it intuitive. It is affordable, as well as well designed. Not just the interface but also the support team deserves praise. Not only is the price fair, but the free trial is also generous. I recommend it. Four stars.
